name: Stormbringer: Stormcloak survives incoming damage and keeps its companion (#3451)
contract: #3451: Stormcloak 804833 reads "Cover yourself in a barrier of volatile energy for $d, causing all attacks against you to have a $h% chance to deal half damage and generate 10 Static.  Stormcloak has a $805161s2% chance to resist dispel effects." Spell.dbc 804833: effect 0 SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB (69) over EffectMiscValue 127, EffectBasePoints 1 + EffectDieSides 1 = a pool of 2; effect 1 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) on 804084, which adds 10 stacks of Static 803102; effect 2 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY (4), EffectBasePoints 49 + 1 = 50, the half-damage percentage; ProcFlags 0x100000 PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE, ProcChance 50, RecoveryTime 30000, DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms. AuraEffect::CalculateAmount adds no bonus term to SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB, so the pool stayed at 2 and Unit::CalcAbsorbResist (Unit.cpp:2546-2552) drained it on the first incoming damage and removed the whole aura, which also removed the linked companion 805161 (SpellAuras.cpp:1284-1295) and with it the 60% dispel resistance. The native clauses are unchanged: the companion comes from the shipped spell_linked_spell row (804833 -> 805161, type 2), the dispel resistance is 805161 effect 1 (EffectBasePoints 59 + 1 = 60), and the Static generation is the DBC-generated proc entry firing 804084 at ProcChance 50 on taken damage. Self-applied Corruption rank 8 (27216) supplies a controlled 150 damage tick every 3 sec as incoming damage; the fixture has regeneration disabled and 100000 maximum health so no tick can kill it, and melee on the dummy keeps it in combat so Static does not decay. The 50% halving roll itself is not assertable on a single hit and is not asserted here; the scenario asserts the structural pool and the survival of both auras. Two Stormcloak windows give at least ten 50% rolls for the Static clause, so a missed observation is under 0.1%.
